correctness.rationale: The proof uses the exact joint law of the first three strict upper records. Totals 6 and 7 give p3=p1^2 Q1 Q2/p2 and p4=p1 Q1 Q2. Hence D3=-(p1 Q1 Q2/p2)D2, so the two local log-concavity inequalities force D2=D3=0. Reparameterizing p2=p1(1-p1)r factors the resulting equation as (r-1)((1-p1)r^2+(1-p1)r+1)=0, forcing r=1. At total n+3, p_n occurs on the record side only in (1,2,n) with positive coefficient and no RHS mass has index n, so induction gives the unique geometric continuation. The included exact checker verifies the algebra and triangularity; finite checks are supplemental only.
